template.name: Ultrasound probe leakage test
template.desc: Converted from the CHS Ansur template “US Probe Test.mtt” (file name). Electrical safety to AS/NZS 3551:2012+A2. The two identical applied part groups in the Ansur template are one group. Not checked against a manufacturer manual (the Mindray Animal manuals folder has none for this model): the checks and the applied part type are as in the Ansur template, for Jonathan to confirm against the device label and the service manual.
